t: Titan TTB774VAC wet and dry vacuum delivers versatile cleaning performance with 1300W power handling dust, debris, sludge and water across domestic and commercial applications. Lightweight 4.7kg vacuum featuring an 11-litre dry capacity and 8-litre wet capacity, with 4 easy-roll castors for easy transport and storage. Comprehensive kit supplied with 1.8m hose and 3 extension tubes to provide over 8m total reach. Includes washable blue cloth filter, foam filter sleeve, dust bag and dual-head floor nozzle for multiple surfaces. Can be used with dust bags for dry cleaning, or without dust bags for wet recovery. Heavy-duty poly tank and float shut-off mechanism ensure reliable operation. Operates at a low noise level of 78dB. Also features a blower function for additional versatility on site.
